components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Operational action with visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #5d6964);border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .16s,border-color .16s,transform .16s;color:var(--fg, #17201e);font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins,'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif);background:var(--accent, #102c2c);color:var(--accent-fg, #f4efde);border-color:var(--accent, #102c2c);font-weight:600} .ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover, #24302c);border-color:var(--accent-hover, #24302c);transform:translateY(-1px)} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #3f8580);outline-offset:3px} .ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)} .ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled native field with a stronger control boundary.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins,'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif)} .ds-input{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #5d6964);border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);font-size:14px;transition:border-color .16s;color:var(--fg, #17201e);font-family:inherit} .ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--fg, #17201e)} .ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #3f8580);outline-offset:3px} .ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--danger, #8f3f2d)} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Current section is marked by fill, border, weight, and aria-current.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Main sections"><button type="button" aria-current="page">Profiles</button><button type="button">Installed Skills</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:4px} .ds-nav button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #5d6964);border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .16s,border-color .16s,transform .16s;color:var(--fg, #17201e);font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins,'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif);justify-content:space-between;padding:0 12px;border-color:transparent;background:transparent;text-align:left} .ds-nav button:hover{background:var(--sunk, var(--warm, #e9ddc9));border-color:transparent} .ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);border-color:var(--border, #b9c0b7);font-weight:600} .ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #3f8580);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Skill Member Tag

components.name: Path Card
components.description: A light bordered panel for a path and its action.
components.css: .ds-path-card{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:12px 12px 12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--border, #b9c0b7);border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);color:var(--fg, #17201e)} .ds-path{font:13px var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono',SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace);overflow-wrap:anywhere} .ds-path-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #5d6964);border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .16s,border-color .16s,transform .16s;color:var(--fg, #17201e);font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins,'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif)} .ds-path-action:hover{background:var(--hover, var(--warm, #e9ddc9));border-color:var(--fg, #17201e)} .ds-path-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #3f8580);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-path-card{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Command Panel
components.description: Wrapping command or output preview on Deep Ocean.

components.name: Availability Switch
components.description: Native button switch with explicit text and aria-checked state.
components.css: .ds-switch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #5d6964);border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .16s,border-color .16s,transform .16s;color:var(--fg, #17201e);font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins,'Avenir Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif);min-height:44px;padding:0;gap:10px;border:0;background:none;font-size:14px} .ds-switch:hover{background:none} .ds-track{position:relative;flex:none;width:36px;height:20px;border:1px solid var(--control-border, #5d6964);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface, #fffaf0);transition:background-color .2s,border-color .2s} .ds-track::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--control-border, #5d6964);transition:transform .42s var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)),background-color .2s} .ds-switch[aria-checked=true] .ds-track{background:var(--fg, #17201e);border-color:var(--fg, #17201e)} .ds-switch[aria-checked=true] .ds-track::after{transform:translateX(16px);background:var(--surface, #fffaf0)} .ds-switch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #3f8580);outline-offset:3px} .ds-switch:active{transform:none} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-switch{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
Fieldwork translates the AFK field notebook into a calm operational ledger. Paper tones hold the workspace; ocean actions and ink rules establish hierarchy. Poppins carries the interface, while IBM Plex Mono makes commands, paths, and skill identifiers distinct.

This document applies only to `packages/afk/web`. The repository-root DESIGN.md remains the incumbent AFK brand record. Source evidence is the shipped `index.html` stylesheet and templates, `client.js` runtime states, and bundled fonts. The approved direction is `docs/specs/afk-pivot-design.md`; product behavior is owned by `docs/specs/afk-pivot.md`. Captures under `.impeccable/review/fieldwork/` evidence the desktop/mobile ledger, folder navigation, empty inventory, and save-error states. The build uses Field Paper for the rail as well as the canvas, despite the direction contract's warm-paper-navigation wording.
keyCharacteristics: Open ruled ledgers with grouped actions and visible scope.
Paper surfaces, ocean primary actions, and verdigris focus.
Compact Poppins hierarchy with mono commands and paths.
Focused native dialogs and five accessible sections on mobile.

rules.name: The Ocean Carries Operations Rule
rules.body: Deep Ocean anchors primary actions and commands; Rust Deep communicates errors and destructive actions.

rules.name: The Interface and Coordinates Rule
rules.body: Poppins carries headings, prose, and controls; Plex Mono distinguishes runnable commands, filesystem paths, and skill identifiers.

rules.name: The Ledger Reflows Rule
rules.body: Narrow layouts move related controls below their item and shorten section labels while preserving access to all five sections.

rules.name: The Overlay Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve soft elevation for dialogs and toast feedback; keep ledger rows flat.

dos: Do use ocean actions, light controls, ink hierarchy, and quiet ruled ledgers.
Do preserve the separate profile details, scope control, and explicit state text.
Do retain five-section mobile navigation and stack row controls when space narrows.
Do keep command and path text wrapping, visible focus, native dialogs, and reduced-motion support.
Do keep save errors next to the entered form and retain the entered values.
donts: Don't replace open ledger rows with elevated decorative card grids.
Don't use Rust Deep as the ordinary primary-action fill.
Don't make state depend only on color or motion.
Don't promote existing uppercase eyebrows or text-glyph status marks into reusable design rules.
